name: EU Horizon Europe Project Eligibility & Policy Rules
description: Pre-check a planned Horizon Europe proposal against official eligibility rules, historical CORDIS benchmarks and company policy.

rules.name: min_consortium_size
rules.message: RIA/IA/CSA actions require at least 3 independent legal entities (General Annex B). Associated partners and third parties do not count.
rules.reference: Horizon Europe Work Programme General Annex B

rules.name: min_distinct_countries
rules.message: Partners must come from at least 3 different Member States or Associated Countries (General Annex B).
rules.reference: Horizon Europe Work Programme General Annex B

rules.name: at_least_one_member_state
rules.message: At least one partner must be established in an EU Member State.
rules.reference: Horizon Europe Work Programme General Annex B

rules.name: eligible_countries_only
rules.message: Partners from non-associated third countries are usually not eligible for funding (they may still participate at their own cost).
rules.reference: Horizon Europe Programme Guide, section 'Countries eligible for funding'

rules.name: budget_within_historical_band
rules.message: Requested EU contribution is outside the 5th–95th percentile of comparable funded projects in CORDIS.
rules.reference: CORDIS Horizon Europe projects (live DuckDB query)

rules.name: max_project_duration
rules.message: Project duration exceeds statutory maximum ceiling of 48 months.
rules.reference: Horizon Europe Work Programme topic conditions

rules.name: min_budget_to_coordinate
rules.message: Company policy: we only coordinate projects with an EU contribution of at least €2M.
